title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
statement:
Given a sorted array of integers, remove duplicates in-place so each unique value appears exactly once.

Print the number of unique elements on the first line, followed by those elements (in order) on the second line.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 10^5
-10^4 <= A[i] <= 10^4
Array is sorted in non-decreasing order.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers in sorted order.
outputFormat:
The first line: the count of unique elements K.
The second line: the first K unique elements space-separated.

examples.explanation: After removing the duplicate 1, the unique elements are [1, 2].
